title: Anti-Frizz Serum for All Hair Types

details.description: Livon Serum is an absolute essential for your hair regime to get the perfect salon finish. This hair serum for women cuts through the frizz and flyaways to give you super-smooth hair. It also gives your hair an ultra-glossy finish within the comfort of your room. It is made using a lightweight formula that is non-sticky and will not weigh your hair down. It is infused with the richness of Moroccan Argan Oil extracts and loaded with micro-smoothers that can readily realign cuticles and tame frizz in a single application, instantly. A small dab is all it takes to detangle, de-frizz, and fight dullness, leaving your hair super-smooth and ultra-glossy. It's your salon in a bottle.
details.usageInstructions:
1. Right after your shower, lightly towel-dry your hair so that it's damp.
2. Pump a small quantity of Livon hair serum onto your palm; just 3-4 drops should work their magic on shoulder-length hair.
3. To ensure you apply the serum evenly, split your hair into two halves.
4. Start applying the serum from the middle of your hair and work your way to the bottom.
5. Dab the rest of it on the crown of your head and you're all set.

title: Anti-Frizz Serum for Rough & Dry Hair

You are going to be waving goodbye to all of these along with all your worries because Livon Serum for Rough and Dry Hair is going to pour life into those locks instantly.
details.usageInstructions:
Right after your shower, lightly towel dry your hair so that it is damp.
Pour a small quantity on your palms. Just 3-4 drops should work their magic on shoulder-length hair.
In case you have longer hair, do use more.
To ensure you apply the serum evenly, split your hair into 2 halves.
Start applying the serum from the middle of your hair and work your way to the bottom.
Dab the rest of it on the crown of your head and you are all set! You can choose to apply the serum on dry hair too.

details.description: Livon Shake and Spray is a bi-phasic hair serum for women that contains Moroccan Argan oil and water-based conditioning actives. It is super light and also contains multivitamins, shine boosters and UV filters that fight against frizzy hair, pollution and dullness. When luck is not on your side, Livon Shake and Spray Serum is! Made for all you girls who spend so much time outdoors, Livon Shake and Spray Serum cuts frizz on the go and boosts gloss instantly. A spray which can easily be carried in the bag, it has Vitamin B fortified water & serum glossers that give you fab hair whenever, wherever. All you need to do is just shake & spray on dry hair to cut away the frizz and get instant smoothness & gloss! So go ahead, keep Livon Shake and Spray Serum in your bag and get express salon finish hair anytime, anywhere.
details.usageInstructions:
1. Split your hair into 2 halves.
2. Shake the product well until it is all pink.
3. Spray away on dry hair.
4. 3-4 sprays on either side should do for shoulder length hair.
5. Use more for longer hair.
6. Run your fingers through your hair to smooth out the tangles.
7. Apply more where it is really unruly.

details.description: There isn't a style in the world that perfectly straight hair doesn't go with, and now achieving it is easier than ever with Livon Super Styler Serum. Crafted for hair styling, Livon Super Styler Serum enables you to straighten your hair at home instantly. With Livon Super Styler Serum, you can get super-straight, super smooth, frizz-free hair for up to 12 hours. Applying Livon Super Styler Serum is beneficial as it not only makes your hair straighter with every application but also protects every strand and reduces hair breakage by five times, which is common when using a straightener. There's no need to shampoo before using this hair serum; simply spray it onto normal hair, let it dry before using a straightener, and achieve any hairstyle you desire. This Livon Super Styler serum helps realign your hair's protein structure every time you use it, resulting in straighter hair with each application. Now, you can straighten your hair at home and achieve super-straight hair quickly with this revolutionary product infused with heat-activated protein. These proteins bind with your hair's polymers to seal cuticles and form a protective layer.
details.usageInstructions:
1. Divide hair into two halves and spray generously on both halves.
2. Using your fingers, comb and spread it in from root to tip.
3. Allow your hair to dry naturally or use a blow dryer.
4. Once dry, use a straightener and get perfectly straight hair.

details.description: Livon Style Pro Hair Clay Wax gives you the freedom to style your hair the way you want, whenever you want. This reworkable hair clay wax offers flexibility to your hair without any hard cast, allowing you to sculpt and style your hair multiple times throughout the day. Tames frizz and resists humidity like a pro with its non-sticky, non-greasy and no-shine formula. Enriched with the incredible properties of Kaolin Clay, it replenishes moisture, leaving your hair irresistibly soft & smooth. Infused with Avocado which is packed with high amounts of monounsaturated fats and Vitamin E, known to deeply nourish hair by penetrating inside, providing healthy hair. details.usageInstructions: Take a generous amount of Livon Style Pro Clay Wax and rub it between your palms. Apply evenly to damp or dry hair, and add definition and texture with your fingers while shaping your desired style. Rework & restyle as frequently as desired.

details.description: Livon Style Pro Curl Cream is a one-stop solution for beautiful & healthy curls. It is a leave-on cream designed especially for curly, coily and wavy hair, that provides intense hydration & nourishment to your curls, leaving them smooth and moisturised. The lightweight, non-sticky and non-greasy formula allows you to style your curls effortlessly without weighing them down. Perfect for enhancing curl definition, leaving your curls soft and bouncy. This curl-defining cream is infused with a rich nourishing duo - Shea Butter & Avocado that intensively hydrates & nourishes curls. Rich in vitamins A and E, Shea Butter has good water-binding properties that provide intense hydration. It retains natural moisture lost in hair and protects your hair from damage caused by chemical treatments, heat styling and environmental aggressors that make hair rough & dry. Avocado is known to deeply nourish the curls, lock in moisture and prevent moisture loss, making them soft, smooth, glossy, and healthy. The proteins, folic acid, magnesium, and minerals present in Avocado oil are known to seal hair cuticles and strengthen hair. Also known to increase hair's resistance against breakage and reduces split ends.
details.usageInstructions:
1. Apply a generous amount of Livon Style Pro Curl Cream on damp hair.
2. Twist hair sections with your fingers and scrunch to define the curls.
3. Let your curls dry naturally.
